system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: we further utilize a unified prompt, as shown in Figure 1 (c), to format each input-output pair and obtain the final instruction tuning data
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt slots: question, toolbox definition, current KG information, history program.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the multi-turn decision-making process of the agent is like walking on the KG along relations
env_context_strategy.note: Environment is a KG explored via extraction tools.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: the input contains the question, toolbox definition, current KG information (i.e., the next candidate relations of the current entity set), and history reasoning program before the current step
context_compaction.note: Knowledge memory replaces raw dialogue history; no explicit truncation/summarization described.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the executor will add it to the KG information for updating the knowledge memory

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: we reformulate the triples into several function calls with the code format, which represents the tool invocation

tool_count.evidence_quote: we design five tools to support the ac- cess to the relations (get_relation), the head/tail en- tities (get_head_entity/get_tail_entity), and entities with specific type or constraint
tool_count.note: 5 extraction + 5 logic (count, intersect, union, judge, end) + 2 semantic (retrieve_relation, disambiguate_entity) = 12; Table 8 in App. B not shown.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: we design three types of tools for LLMs reasoning over KG, i.e., extraction, semantic, and logic tools
edit_primitive.note: No file editing tool; toolbox operates on KG only.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: since the format and usage for each tool have been defined in a unified way, the toolbox for KG can be flexibly extended according to the real needs

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: we construct a supporting toolbox for easing the utilization of the KG information
protocol_standardization.note: No protocol mentioned anywhere in the paper.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The KG-Agent framework autonomously iterates the above tool selection and memory updation process to perform step-by-step reasoning

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the LLM-based planner se- lects a tool to interact with KG at each step
planning_granularity.note: Planner selects one call per step; no stored plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: the core instruction-tuned LLM (Section 4.2), referred to as the LLM-based planner, the multifunctional toolbox (Section 4.1), the KG-based executor

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: It mainly contains four components, i.e., the core instruction-tuned LLM (Section 4.2), referred to as the LLM-based planner

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: designing autonomous reasoning approaches that can actively make decisions during reasoning, without human assistance

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the knowledge memory to record the context and currently useful information in the whole process

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: The later two parts are initialized as an empty list, which will be constantly updated at each step
long_term_memory.note: Memory is per-question only; nothing persists across runs.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: The later two parts are initialized as an empty list, which will be constantly updated at each step after LLM generating the function call and executor invoking the corresponding tool.

self_verification.evidence_quote: After the planner generates the function call, the KG-based ex- ecutor will execute it using a program compiler.
self_verification.note: No verification/critic stage described; a judge tool exists but is a KG condition check, not output verification.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Once reaching the answer enti- ties, the agent will automatically stop the iterative process.

rollback.evidence_quote: It can cache or operate the intermediate variables, and extract new entities or relations from the KG.
rollback.note: Read-only KG access; no revert mechanism described.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: ending the reasoning process with the current entity set as the final answer(s) (end)

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: the KG-based ex- ecutor will execute it using a program compiler
execution_isolation.note: Function calls executed in-process against the KG; no isolation described.

permission_model.evidence_quote: the planner needs to invoke tools from the pre-defined toolbox
permission_model.note: Only the fixed toolbox functions can be executed.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: we evaluate KG- Agent on both in-domain and out-of-domain tasks including KG-based question answering (KGQA) and open domain question answering (ODQA)
eval_hooks.note: Evaluation described in paper; no harness eval hook code available (no repo evidence for this system).

guardrails.evidence_quote: the planner needs to invoke tools from the pre-defined toolbox to address four types of task requirements
guardrails.note: Restriction to a fixed toolbox is the only action constraint described.

target_domain.evidence_quote: an autonomous LLM-based agent framework, called KG-Agent, which enables a small LLM to actively make deci- sions until finishing the reasoning process over KGs
target_domain.note: KG reasoning / question answering; no swe or web domain.

open_source.evidence_quote: Our code and data will be publicly released.
open_source.note: Promised release; no LICENSE seen for KG-Agent itself (the linked repo evidence is BioKGBench, a different system).

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: we perform su- pervised fine-tuning on a small LLM (i.e., LLaMA- 7B)

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Our code and data will be publicly released.
primary_artifact.note: No KG-Agent repo in the evidence; coded from the paper.

first_release_date.note: Basis: arXiv v1 date, no tags available.
